subject: StandaloneMmPkg/Core: Move MMI depth tracker below MMI check
reasons: Paired with adjacent commit bd8667a7fd which applies the identical fix (moving depth counter increment below handler-presence check) in a parallel file (MdeModulePkg/Core/PiSmmCore/Smi.c vs StandaloneMmPkg/Core/Mmi.c)
The SMI/MMI cores are structurally mirrored; the same statement reordering pattern applies to both
Well-defined before/after: move mXxxManageCallingDepth++ from before the handler-lookup to after the handler is confirmed present
candidate_pattern: Match: mXxxManageCallingDepth++ followed by WillReturn = FALSE; Status = EFI_NOT_FOUND; ... head lookup; and reorder to place mXxxManageCallingDepth++ after the successful head lookup.
